full_judgment: 2. The plaintiff's father instituted a suit for specific performance of contract against defendant's mother in respect of 13 gondas of land being part of the suit land and got a decree, but a portion of the decree was set aside. Thereafter the plaintiff's father and defendant's mother both died. The plaintiff filed Appeal No. 1084 in the High Court Division but withdrew the same with permission to refine the same on 15-2-84. On 3-6-84 the defendant came from the town to the house of his friend Jamal Ahmed at the village and called the plaintiff and the defendant proposed for selling 3.08 acres of his agricultural land for Taka 1,05,000.00. On 3-7-94 plaintiff collected Taka 80,000.00 on depositing a stamp with promise to sell certain land by himself to Golam Kibria and by his mother to his vendors wife Noor Banu. Thereafter accordingly two sale deeds were registered one on 10-12-84 Ext-10 and the other on 11-12-84. Ext 10(Ka). Plaintiff collected Taka 5,000.00 from the capital of his grocery business. On 4-7-84 PW 2, a deed writer of Gachbaria came to the court building at Chittagong at 8-00 AM to obtain a khatian for his client. On the same date at 8-00/9-00 AM PW 6 met the plaintiff at the shop of PW 3 situated within Jahur Hawkers Market. Then both told him for a deed writer. He replied that they would find a deed writer named Zari Ahmed Munshi in the Court Building. On their request he went to the Court Building with them and found PW 2 in the record room of the Criminal Court. Then they came to the defendant's house at 17 Kazam Ali Road where the bainanama written by PW 2 was executed by PWs 3 to 6 who all had shops in their Hawkers Market. The defendant having refused to execute the sale deed the suit for specific performance of contract was filed.
